videos.title: Minutrel — Open-source time tracking, by project
videos.summary: A clear introduction to Minutrel: open-source time tracking by project, useful work notes and reports, on your own computer or your own team server.

A clear introduction to Minutrel: open-source time tracking by project, useful work notes and reports, on your own computer or your own team server.

Minutrel is open-source time tracking by project. Work on your own computer, or connect the browser and desktop app to a team server you control.

In this video:
• Project-based time tracking
• Work context and monthly reports
• Personal and self-hosted team workspaces
